title: Khao Soi Kai (Northern Thai Coconut Curry Noodle Soup with Chicken)

items: 6 dried red chilies (soaked in warm water, deseeded)
1 thumb-size piece galangal (or ginger if unavailable)
1 stalk lemongrass (tender inner part, finely sliced)
1 tsp turmeric root (or 1 tsp ground turmeric)
500 g (1 lb) chicken drumsticks or thighs, bone-in
Vegetable oil for deep-frying (for crispy noodles garnish)

instructions.title: 1. Prepare Curry Paste
steps: In a mortar & pestle (traditional) or blender, pound/blend all curry paste ingredients into a fine paste.
Toast dry spices first for fragrance before blending.

instructions.title: 2. Fry the Paste & Cook Chicken
steps: Heat oil in a heavy pot or wok over medium heat.
Fry curry paste until aromatic and oil separates (3–5 min).
Add half of the coconut milk, stirring until glossy and fragrant.
Add chicken pieces, coat well in the paste.

instructions.title: 3. Build the Broth
steps: Pour in remaining coconut milk and chicken stock.
Add palm sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, and salt.
Simmer gently 25–30 minutes until chicken is tender and soup is rich.

instructions.title: 4. Prepare Noodles
steps: Cook fresh egg noodles in boiling water until just tender. Drain.
Reserve one portion (about a handful) of noodles for frying.
Deep-fry reserved noodles until golden and crisp. Drain on paper towel.

instructions.title: 5. Assemble & Serve
steps: Ladle hot curry soup with chicken over the noodles.
Garnish with sliced red onion, pickled mustard greens, coriander, and lime wedge.
Drizzle with chili oil for extra spice.

tips: Balance is key: Taste the broth before serving – adjust saltiness (fish sauce), sweetness (palm sugar), creaminess (coconut milk), or acidity (lime at table).
Texture contrast: The crispy noodles on top must stay crunchy against the silky soup. Fry in small batches for best crispness.
Aromatic depth: Frying the curry paste properly until fragrant is crucial for authentic flavor.
Presentation: Use wide bowls, nest noodles neatly, and layer garnishes for a refined look.
